The Harbour Desk

A solid oak standing desk, made by hand in Falmouth. Fixed height £890, sit-stand frame £1,290. Free UK delivery.

Materials

European oak from managed forests, finished with hard-wax oil. Steel frame powder-coated in graphite.

Dimensions

160 cm wide, 80 cm deep. Fixed height 74 cm; the sit-stand frame rises from 65 cm to 125 cm.

Yes, natural oil or dark wax at no extra cost.

Return it within 30 days for a full refund; see our returns policy.
